title: A Jointly Efficient and Near-Optimal Algorithm for Heteroskedastic Generalized Linear Bandits with Adversarial Corruptions
abstract: arXiv:2602.10971v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider heteroskedastic generalized linear bandits (GLBs) with adversarial corruptions and propose \texttt{HCW-GLB-OMD}, a simple algorithm that combines an online mirror descent (OMD)-based estimator with Hessian-based confidence weights. Although both components are well studied, establishing guarantees for the combined algorithm requires a nontrivial analysis. We establish a corruption-robust confidence sequence using technical tools not required in prior analyses, including a weighted likelihood supermartingale and a self-bounding argument. For the regret analysis, we derive a new Hessian potential lemma to handle the interaction between adversarial corruption and adaptive confidence weighting. For self-concordant GLMs, we prove a high-probability regret bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\bigl( d \sqrt{\sum_t g(\tau_t) \dot\mu_{t,\star}} + d^2 g_{\max} \kappa + d(1+\kappa)(C\vee1) \bigr)$, where $\dot\mu_{t,\star}$ is the slop

translated_abstract: 我们研究了带有对抗性污染的异方差广义线性赌博机（GLBs），并提出了一种简单算法 HCW-GLB-OMD，该算法将基于在线镜像下降（OMD）的估计器与基于Hessian矩阵的置信度权重相结合。尽管这两个组成部分都已被充分研究，但要为该组合算法建立理论保证仍需要非平凡的分析。我们利用先前分析中不需要的技术工具（包括加权似然上鞅和自约束论证）建立了抗污染的置信序列。在遗憾分析方面，我们推导了一个新的Hessian势函数引理，以处理对抗性污染与自适应置信度加权之间的相互作用。对于自协和（self-concordant）广义线性模型，我们证明了高概率遗憾界 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\bigl( d \sqrt{\sum_t g(\tau_t) \dot\mu_{t,\star}} + d^2 g_{\max} \kappa + d(1+\kappa)(C\vee1) \bigr)$，其中 $\dot\mu_{t,\star}$ 是……
tldr: 本文提出将基于在线镜像下降的估计器与基于Hessian的置信度权重相结合的HCW-GLB-OMD算法，为带对抗性污染的异方差广义线性赌博机实现了联合高效且近最优的高概率遗憾保证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes HCW-GLB-OMD, which combines an OMD-based estimator with Hessian-based confidence weights to achieve jointly efficient and near-optimal high-probability regret guarantees for heteroskedastic generalized linear bandits with adversarial corruptions.
